patterns.note: A minimalist, centered single-column layout with generous vertical spacing and ample whitespace, focusing attention on the central visual element.
Exclusive use of a single elegant serif font for all textual elements, creating a consistent, refined, and artistic voice across headings and labels.
A highly restricted color palette dominated by white, a soft light blue for primary text, and the natural blues and whites of the sky imagery.
The top-level navigation and settings elements ('Night off', 'About', 'Palette') remain sticky at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls down the page.
The primary content area is a large, full-width mosaic composed of numerous small image tiles, which scrolls naturally with the page content.

technique_notes: A single elegant serif font is used for all textual elements, with size and weight variations to establish hierarchy while maintaining a cohesive aesthetic.
The primary visual content is presented as a large, grid-based mosaic of smaller image tiles, filling the central content area and serving as the page's hero.

The top navigation bar is implemented as a sticky element, maintaining its position at the top of the viewport using CSS positioning, potentially with subtle transitions defined by css-keyframes for its appearance or state changes.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized elegant serif headings (~3-4x body) with delicate, small serif labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle; the main image container has slightly rounded corners.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy; generous vertical spacing and ample whitespace around content blocks.

standout: The site's distinctive feature is its central, full-width mosaic of sky images, which serves as both the hero and the primary content, creating a unique visual data presentation rather than a typical image or video hero. This artistic approach to displaying a collection of images is highly memorable.
